climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: An enduring geographical indication covering the North Island's wine areas, from Northland and Auckland down to Hawke's Bay, Gisborne and Wairarapa. Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay lead at about 24% and 23% of the vines, with Pinot Gris, Merlot and Pinot Noir behind.
